text: City Council on July 19, 20, 21 and 22, 2022, adopted this Item, and has forwarded the Item and Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 27, 2022) from the Executive Director, Corporate Real Estate Management to the CreateTO Board and the Toronto Transit Commission Board for their information and City Council has requested the CreateTO Board and the Toronto Transit Commission Board to keep Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 27, 2022) from the Executive Director, Corporate Real Estate Management confidential until the conditions specified in Part 3 of City Council's decision are met.

The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 27, 2022) from the Executive Director, Corporate Real Estate Management remain confidential until the conditions specified in Part 3 of City Council's decision are met.
